title: Desvigne short-changing pay, and Herbert Leary's band
summary: Desvigne would cut each man's pay, explained through the 'see for yourself' saying; Brunious also mentions Herbert Leary's band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. At that time, yeah. So, uh, well, let me see what else about Sidney Desvina I know.
Well, that was about all, I know one thing. Well, that's all right.

Yeah, well, I know one thing, Sidney used to cut you a lot, too, man. You see, at that time, man, Jobs used to pay $3. You know? And, uh, well, each man in the band used to get $3, man, sure. Sidney said, well, man, you see, and people said, man, you see for yourself. You know? That was a very saying, a very famous saying at that time, you know? Like if you go play a dance, you know? People say, and just very, maybe about four or five people would come to the dance. And then when the time come to pay off, now you can play it all night, you know? When the time comes to pay off, the man come and say, man, you see for yourself, you know? Yeah, see? You see? So that's where that saying come in at you, see for yourself, you know? Good evening. Uh-huh. See? You see for yourself, you know? So, uh, well, Sidney used to cut you some time. He'd say, well, man, he'd say, man, so you see for yourself, man, you had too many people, so instead of paying $3,000, he'd just give you $2.5, sometimes $2.75, you know? He always cut a quarter off each man or something like that, you know? Yeah, well, outside of that, I mean, he was all right. I worked with these bands a pretty good while. All right. Oh. All right. That's all right. And, uh, outside of that, I mean, Sidney was all right. Let me see who else, what other big dad I worked with around there? Walter Pichon, Sidney Desvene. I worked with Herbert Leverett's band, too. Yeah. Well, Herbert had a, he had a nice band, also.
